title: "Proc Mixed"

---

This is an example of a mixed model in SAS.

```{r, engine='sas', engine.path='/usr/local/SASHome/SASFoundation/9.4/bin/sas_en'}
data ingot;
infile '/home/gwf/sync/classes/537/sas/ch1/bond.dat' firstobs=1;
input ingot metal $ pressure;
run;

proc mixed data=ingot  method=REML;
class ingot metal;
model pressure =  metal / noint s ddfm=satterth;
random ingot;
run;

proc mixed data=ingot method=REML;
class ingot metal;
model pressure = metal;
repeated /subject=ingot type=cs;
run;
endsas;
```
